# `pairsp`

Run pairwise spatial analyses (Squidpy interactions, distance bootstrap, and PCF) with plots/raw exports

- Wrapper: [`job_pairwise_spatial.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_pairwise_spatial.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_cellcharter`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.pairwise_spatial`

## Inputs

- pairwise_spatial.input_adata_path (fallback: process.output_adata_path, then process.input_adata_path)
- adata.obs keys configured in pairwise_spatial (population_obs, roi_obs, X/Y coords, optional groupby_obs)

## Outputs

- general.qc_folder/pairwise_spatial.output_subdir (default QC/Pairwise_Spatial)

## Configuration

- general, process, pairwise_spatial, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl pairsp
```
